files.content: .block-timeline1{width:100%;padding:128px 24px;background:#fff;color:#0a0a0a;font:400 16px/24px system-ui,sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box}.block-timeline1 *{box-sizing:border-box}.block-timeline1 ol{max-width:576px;margin:0 auto;padding:0;list-style:none;text-align:center}.block-timeline1 li,.tl1-step{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}.tl1-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:96px;height:96px;flex-shrink:0;border:2px solid #171717;border-radius:50%}.tl1-icon svg{width:32px;height:32px}.block-timeline1 h2{font-size:30px;font-weight:500;line-height:36px;letter-spacing:normal;margin:8px 0}.block-timeline1 p{font:400 16px/24px ui-monospace,monospace;color:#737373;margin:0}.tl1-connector{display:block;width:2px;height:144px;margin:12px 0;background-image:linear-gradient(#000 10%,transparent 0%);background-position:left center;background-size:3px 15px;background-repeat:repeat-y}.block-timeline1 button,.block-timeline1 a{font:inherit;margin-top:12px;padding:6px 12px;color:inherit;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:6px;background:white;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}.block-timeline1 :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #737373;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:640px){.block-timeline1{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}.block-timeline1 ol{max-width:576px}}
